title: Planning an impossible meal
literal_meaning: Tamarind from the sky, fish from Chilika.
explanation: The source uses ingredients brought together in an impossible way to mock an unrealistic proposition. Chilika supplies an image in the saying, not proof of where it originated.
meaning_odia: ଅସମ୍ଭବ ଜିନିଷକୁ ଏକାଠି କରି କିଛି ହେବ ବୋଲି ଭାବିବାକୁ ଏହି କଥା ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ କରେ।
usage_example: A proposal depends on money, time and materials that nobody can provide. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
